title: eval-harness: add prompt-set regression CI hook and GH Actions gating
author: Asha Patel
commits: a1f3d2c: add GitHub Actions workflow for eval-harness prompt regression gating
b4c2e1a: implement ci_hooks runner and cli wrapper for CI integration
c9d7b6f: add canonical prompt sets and threshold configs for core models
d8e5f4b: flakiness fixes and better logging for metric collection
description: Motivation: prevent regressions in generation quality caused by model or infra changes by gating merges on prompt-set evals run in CI. This PR introduces a CI hook that runs a focused subset of the eval-harness prompt sets and enforces configurable quality thresholds. The hook is implemented as a small runner (eval-harness/ci_hooks.py) and a GitHub Actions workflow (.github/workflows/eval-prompt-regression-gate.yml). Key behavior: run lightweight prompt-set bundles for changed models/routes, compute configured metrics (BLEU/ROUGE/semantic-similarity/accuracy depending on test), compare against thresholds from eval-harness/thresholds/core_thresholds.yaml, and fail the job on regressions. The description below documents scope, config, testing, and rollout.
review_thread: Carlos Mendes (review): Overall this looks good — two concerns: 1) GH Actions runtime increase for the main branch; 2) thresholds for newer models look tight. Can we make the workflow conditional on label or changed files?

Asha Patel (author): Good points — added file-path conditional logic and a label override (label: run-eval-gate) so only PRs touching serving/runtime, models, or prompt sets will trigger by default. Thresholds are read from thresholds/ and can be relaxed per-model via linear ticket ENG-4300.

Priya Rao (review): Please add a short-circuit when CI infra is under load (we have a spike detection env var) to avoid blocking releases. Also please surface the metric breakdown in the GH Actions summary so SRE/product can triage.

Asha Patel (author): Added a short-circuit env EVAL_GATE_ALLOW_ON_SPIKE and a post-job summary artifact with per-prompt metrics. The workflow uploads a JSON artifact for debugging and posts a succinct summary to the PR comments when failures occur.
Evan Li (review): Tests look fine. Left a nit around the logging format and a suggestion to make thresholds namespaced by model-version. Approved after author response.
Asha Patel (author): Addressed nits and namespacing; updated thresholds file and test fixtures. Marking for squash-merge once CI passes.
release_notes: Add CI gating for prompt-set regressions: GitHub Actions workflow and eval-harness CI hook which run lightweight prompt sets and enforce configurable quality thresholds. Workflows are conditional and support a label override. Adds core prompt sets and threshold defaults.
